Name: Tool Upgrade Duration Changer
Author: GrimatGaming
Description:
Tired of waiting 2 days for your tool upgrade, or maybe you want to make things more difficult by having tool upgrades take longer. This is the mod for you.

This will allow you to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change how long you have to wait for tool upgrades, along with updating the tool upgrade dialogue for Clint that fits more with his personality, and is appropriate for how long you set the wait for.

Set the "Required Days for Upgrade" to 0 for instant tool upgrades. Otherwise you can choose to set the required days from 1 to 14. [s]The default setting is 2 like the vanilla game.

[/s]Currently not compatible with Multiplayer, but I am working on an update to fix.

[b]U[size=4]pdates for V1.1.3 -

[/size][/b]Updated the code to specifically use non-translated name when applying upgrades, resolving issues in non-english versions of the game

[b]U[size=4]pdates for V1.1.2 -

[/size][/b]Fixed bug introduced in 1.1.1 where trashcan upgrades were duplicated a giving a 'free' iridium upgrade. Also added the German translation provided by Th3Tob1.

[b]U[/b][size=4][b]pdates for V1.1.1 -[/b]

[/size]Fixed bug where trash can upgrades were being sent to the players inventory and not being applied when the game language was not English. Upgrading your trashcan will now remove any that were added to the inventory in error.

[b]U[size=4]pdates for V1.1.0 -[/size][/b]

Separated tool upgrades into Copper, Steel, Gold, Irridium, and Custom (for modded tool upgrades such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21450]Prismatic Tools Continued[/url])

Moved dialogue away from being hardcoded to allow for translation mods

New defaults as below. Will need to update your preferences as the previous configuration for 1.0.0 is now redundant.

Copper Upgrades - 1 days
Steel Upgrades - 3 Days
Gold Upgrades - 5 days
Iridium Upgrades - 7 days
Custom Upgrades - 2 Days
